title: Choose the bolder visual world
question: The bolder roll assigned Capability Sound Clash. The assembled/exploded machine pair is now a functional scroll primitive in the strongest candidates. Keep the roll, take an alternate, use the standing canon, or steer again.

options.label: Capability Sound Clash
options.thesis: VEEMAP’s machine and its capabilities compete for billing in one fluorescent, screen-printed industrial clash.
options.viewport: An exploded machine strikes across ranked VISION, MOTION, CONTROL and HEALTH billings, then locks assembled on scroll.
options.risk: The poster energy can outrun engineering credibility if the machine stops feeling physically exact.

raised.raise: Capability names resolve into instrument-like evidence instead of remaining slogans.
The machine stays the primary spatial object while type supplies the pressure.

options.label: The Technology Planogram
options.thesis: Machine capabilities face the visitor as a saturated wall of modules, each turning from promise to engineering proof.
options.viewport: A credible machine is flanked by bold module facings that flip to reveal AI vision, HMI, motion and health evidence.
options.case: The modularity is clear, but manufacturing leaders identify less readily with retail shelf language than with the assigned machine-led clash.
options.risk: Packaging cues can make serious capital equipment feel consumerized.
options.kept: Exceptional scanning speed and a strong front-to-proof interaction.

options.label: The Performance Bridge
options.thesis: A row of ballistic instruments makes speed, vision confidence, uptime and machine health feel alive beneath the mechanism.
options.viewport: The machine assembles above a continuous meter bridge whose needles respond as each technology layer activates.
options.case: It identifies immediately as engineered instrumentation and explains capability well, but the repeated meters are less ownable than the assigned typographic hierarchy.
options.risk: Too many needles can imply decorative dashboards rather than trustworthy machine evidence.

options.label: Flowfield Assembly
options.thesis: Every mechanism displaces a visible field, turning pick-and-place timing and process flow into one irreversible composition.
options.viewport: An exploded machine floats over process streamlines that bend around AI vision, motion and control interventions.
options.case: The flow metaphor is memorable but requires more explanation than the assigned direction for both audience identification and product clarity.
options.risk: Organic fluid behavior can obscure VEEMAP’s controlled mechanical precision.
options.kept: A beautiful way to visualize invisible process influence without fake data.

options.label: Multiplane Commissioning
options.thesis: A conceptually accurate machine is commissioned layer by layer as scroll moves through painted depth planes and precise mechanical states.
options.viewport: The camera travels from exploded to assembled state while vision, motion, HMI and health each occupy a focusable depth plane.
options.case: It beats the leader on both axes: the machine remains instantly recognizable and every technology layer becomes spatially legible without exposing proprietary detail.
options.risk: The painted atmosphere must never soften tolerances, mechanisms or control labels into fantasy.

options.label: Night-Shift Dreamfold
options.lineage: a sleeping city folded into a quilt
options.thesis: The factory floor folds into one sleeping machine whose districts dream in vision, motion, control and health states.
options.viewport: A machine and factory map fold together at night, with predictive alerts appearing as waking seams before dawn.
options.case: It creates emotional distinction but loses to the leader on immediate product clarity and executive manufacturing relevance.
options.risk: The dream metaphor can make preventive machine-health monitoring feel less concrete.
options.kept: A humane night-shift narrative and graceful reduced-motion fallback.

canonCard.label: Premium Industrial Integrator
canonCard.thesis: A world-class machine-builder homepage using immaculate product rendering, restrained typography and direct proof.
canonCard.viewport: A studio-lit machine hero, concise positioning, proven capabilities and a direct requirements enquiry.
canonCard.risk: It is credible and premium, but intentionally less distinctive than the bolder hand.
